definitions.explanation: The ninth month of the year. The new school term resumes after summer vacation. Features the autumn equinox.

examples.japanese: {九月|くがつ}から{学校|がっこう}が{始|はじ}まります。
{九月|くがつ}は{涼|すず}しくなります。
{九月|くがつ}に{台風|たいふう}が{来|き}ます。

notes: September uses く (9), not きゅう. The second semester begins in September in Japan. The autumn equinox (秋分の日) falls around September 23rd and is a national holiday.
